After a series of disturbing encounters, they are forced to confront their deepest fears when the stranger's true motives are revealed.

programme.title: Trespassers
programme.desc: Two couples, each working through relationship issues, rent a gorgeous house in the desert for a sex- and drug-fueled escape from reality. As tensions escalate throughout a debaucherous night, things take an unexpected turn when a woman claiming to be a neighbor with car trouble shows up at the door. She seems harmless enough, or so they think.

programme.title: The Houses October Built 2
programme.desc: Still recovering from the trauma of being kidnapped on the previous Halloween by the Blue Skeleton - a group that takes extreme haunt to another level - five friends decide they must face their fears to move on. Heading back out on the road to visit more haunted house attractions, new terror begins when signs of the Blue Skeleton start appearing again.

programme.title: Cabin Fever: Patient Zero
programme.desc: Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: Corky (Anthony Hopkins), a failed magician, adopts a new ventriloquist act with an abrasive dummy named Fats, and suddenly finds himself lined up for a television show. When the unbalanced Corky fears he won't pass the required mental exam, he runs away with Fats to his hometown, where he meets an old love from high school, Peggy (Ann-Margret). Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Puppet Master: The Littlest Reich
programme.desc: A man sells a nefarious-looking puppet at a small-town convention for some quick cash. Terror soon strikes when an ancient evil animates the other puppets and sends them on a bloody killing spree.

programme.title: Night of the Hunted
programme.desc: When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.

programme.title: Trick
programme.desc: From the director of My Bloody Valentine. Always choose treat.

programme.title: ATM
programme.desc: A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.

programme.title: Mischief Night
programme.desc: Emily, blind since a car accident killed her mother, has to protect herself and loved ones from an intruder.

programme.title: Bone Tomahawk
programme.desc: In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A film student (Jason Scott Campbell) finds a video camera that contains footage of himself committing murder.

programme.title: Would You Rather
programme.desc: Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly.

programme.title: Freeway Killer
programme.desc: Californian serial killer William Bonin (Scott Anthony Leet) searches for victims on the state's highways.

programme.title: The Postcard Killings
programme.desc: A New York detective investigates the death of his daughter, who was murdered while on her honeymoon in London, the victim of an apparent serial killer.

programme.title: Asperger's Are Us
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age documentary, four friends on the Autism spectrum who have bonded through humor and performed as the comedy troupe "Asperger's Are Us" will prepare for one final, ambitious show before going their separate ways.

programme.title: The Last Laugh
programme.desc: Outrageously funny and thought-provoking, THE LAST LAUGH upends comedy's ultimate taboo by asking legends like Mel Brooks if you can joke about the Holocaust, and what else-9/11, AIDS, racism-is off-limits in a society that prizes free speech.

programme.title: Cycles
programme.desc: An apprehensive young man moves into university halls, and the sudden feeling of isolation forces him into an argument with his older brother about identity, love, and the repression of dreams.

programme.title: Betting on the Bride
programme.desc: A womanizer bets that he can get someone to accept his marriage proposal after just 30 days of dating. What he doesn't know is that the woman he targets has serious commitment issues.

programme.title: Run Robot Run!
programme.desc: Kent Weston lives in the not-too-distant future. He is more organized than a day planner and more regimented than a Marine when His goals of dating his pretty co-worker Allison are thrown into disarray with the arrival of Adam, an all-too-human robot.

programme.title: Sister
programme.desc: Sister brings the timely topic of youth and psychotropic drug prescription to the forefront with insight and grace. Reid Scott delivers a nuanced performance as the estranged brother forced into caring for his troubled adolescent sister (Grace Kaufman).

programme.title: Rites of Passage
programme.desc: Feature length drama made collaboratively with a group of young people who dive below the surface of their often tough exteriors to reveal what's going on inside.

programme.title: Ashens and the Polybius Heist
programme.desc: A heist like no other! A motley crew of misfits hunts down an infamous 80's arcade game that can supposedly control people's minds in this chart-topping feel-good British comedy.

programme.title: Get the Girl
programme.desc: When a strange girl appears do you help, or mind your business? A retired hitman and his trainee get pulled into the shit when they decide to save a girl who escapes from trafficking. Sometimes you gotta do bad things to bad people.

programme.title: A Rough Draft
programme.desc: A video game designer is stripped of his identity and recruited by a mysterious force to be the gatekeeper of a multi-dimensional portal.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Cafe owner Alex's love life is ignited when Rachel walks through his doors. What begins as a shot of love quickly spins into a mystery spanning space and time when Alex discovers the woman of his dreams may only exist in his dreams.

programme.title: Rain Beau's End
programme.desc: When a progressive lesbian couple adopts a boy with a misunderstood genetic condition that was thought to predispose boys to violence and criminality, they must come to grips with their hardline stance on acceptance and toxic masculinity.

programme.title: Slant
programme.desc: Melbourne. 1999. Christmas time! In this darkly comic thriller, a rogue journalist unearths the sordid secrets of an infamous missing socialite for the scoop of a lifetime while unwittingly dredging up his family trauma.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: In this disaster movie, Americans and Soviets must put aside their differences to save civilization from a huge meteor bearing down on the planet. Paul Bradley (Sean Connery) enlists the expertise of fellow scientist Alexei Dubov (Brian Keith), who is joined by his beautiful assistant, Tatiana Donskaya (Natalie Wood). Although Paul and Tatiana are attracted to each other, they wisely focus on taking out the meteor, which may still cause massive destruction even if it is partially damaged.

programme.title: Cosmic Contact
programme.desc: Three college students try to create a device capable of reaching beyond the boundaries of the known universe. Unfortunately for them, they succeed....

programme.title: All I Want Is You
programme.desc: After holding her man down on a long 4-year bid, Chloe is ready to risk it all when another woman tries to steal her man.

programme.title: The Knock Knock Man
programme.desc: A group of teens dare each other to summon a mysterious figure from an old urban legend. What was supposed to be a harmless game turns deadly when one of them breaks an unspoken rule, unleashing the terrifying entity into the real world.

programme.title: Nochebuena
programme.desc: A return home on Christmas Eve transports Junior back to a familiar life of old traditions, lots of coquito, and the one that got away.

programme.title: Christmas with a View
programme.desc: Thunder Mountain Ski Resort hired celebrity chef Shane Roarke as its new head chef for Christmas. Clara isn't very excited, but their paths continue to cross. Will their shared passion for cooking unite them, or will secrets keep them apart?

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Mouse Trap
programme.desc: Stuck working the late shift at the amusement park arcade, Alex receives a surprise visit from her friends on her 21st birthday. However, their night of fun soon turns into a fight for survival when a killer dressed as Mickey Mouse crashes the party.

programme.title: Shiver Me Timbers
programme.desc: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.title: In Flight
programme.desc: The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after that.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: Shadow Dancer
programme.desc: Arrested after a failed bombing attempt, a single mother and IRA member (Andrea Riseborough) falls into the hands of a British agent (Clive Owen) who offers her a choice: Spy on her IRA comrades, or spend a long prison term away from her young son.

programme.title: The World's Fastest Indian
programme.desc: New Zealander Burt Munro spent years perfecting his classic Indian motorcycle. The year is 1967, and Burt takes his machine to Utah's salt flats, where he attempts the impossible, using his dream bike to set a new world's record for speed. Based on a true story, the record Munro set more than three decades ago still has not been broken to this day.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: After hearing that her boyfriend/pimp cheated on her while she was in jail, a transgender sex worker and her best friend set out to find him and teach him and his new lover a lesson.

programme.title: All Good Things
programme.desc: Heir to a real-estate dynasty, David Marks (Ryan Gosling) lives in the shadow of his father, Sanford (Frank Langella). He takes a chance at true love when he meets Katie (Kirsten Dunst), a woman of modest origins who sees David's real worth as a person, not just his family's wealth. David and Katie marry and plan to build a life together, but their once-loving relationship deteriorates after David gives in to his father's demand that he work in the family business.

programme.title: Skate Kitchen
programme.desc: Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes dramatically when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders. As she journeys deeper into this raw New York City subculture, she begins to understand the true meaning of friendship.

programme.title: A Kind of Murder
programme.desc: Walter Stackhouse is rich, successful and unhappily married to the beautiful but damaged Clara. His desire to be free of her feeds his obsession with Kimmel, a man suspected of brutally murdering his own wife. When Walter and Kimmel's lives become dangerously intertwined, a ruthless police detective becomes convinced he has found the murderer. But as the lines blur between innocence and intent, who, in fact, is the real killer?

programme.title: Cashback
programme.desc: Would-be artist Ben (Sean Biggerstaff) realizes he has an extraordinary way of dealing with the tedium of his dead-end job stocking shelves at a store - he has acquired the ability to halt time and explore the world while the rest of the earth's population remains frozen in place. Ben's unusual talent helps him forget about a nasty breakup with his ex-girlfriend Suzy (Michelle Ryan), but he begins to stop time so often that he may miss out on a new romance with his coworker Sharon (Emilia Fox).

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Homeless and saved from almost certain death by a hospital staff, Lucas (Paul Dano) has nowhere to turn. The hospital staffers, though, are so taken with his kindness and generosity that they take up a collection to give him a fresh start. But when he's discharged, Lucas meets some fellow homeless people and gives away all the money he's just received. His roommate at the hospital, Jacques (Brian Cox), is also affected by the young man, and offers him a job at his bar.

programme.title: Ondine
programme.desc: Fisherman Syracuse (Colin Farrell), a recovering alcoholic, lives with his daughter, Annie (Alison Barry), in a small village on the Irish coast. One afternoon, a mystifying and beautiful girl, Ondine (Alicja Bachleda), gets caught in his nets as he wades along the water. Aboard the boat, Ondine brings Syracuse great luck, seemingly drawing the fish towards his nets. However, the fisherman starts to fear that Ondine may not be meant for this life.

programme.title: A Long Way Down
programme.desc: Four strangers who planned to jump off the same roof on New Year's Eve join together as a kind of family and give themselves six weeks to find valid reasons to live.

programme.title: Mr. Nobody: Extended Director's Cut
programme.desc: In 2092, the last mortal human on Earth reflects on his long past and thinks about the lives he might have led.

programme.title: Please Stand By
programme.desc: Wendy sees things differently: she's fiercely independent, with a brilliant mind and a mischievous sense of hilarity. Wendy also has autism. To her, people are an indecipherable code and the world's a confusing place. Inspired by her no-nonsense caregiver, Wendy comes of age and escapes from her care home on the road trip of a lifetime to deliver her 500-page script to a writing competition.

programme.title: Prince Avalanche
programme.desc: Two road-crew workers (Paul Rudd, Emile Hirsch) spend the summer of 1988 isolated and away from their city lives, eventually finding themselves at odds with each other and their women back home.

programme.title: Nobody Walks
programme.desc: A young woman's (Olivia Thirlby) arrival sparks a surge of energy into a laid-back, artistic Los Angeles household, forcing the residents to confront their own fears and desires in an intricate dance of lust, denial and deception.

programme.title: Main Street
programme.desc: A stranger (Colin Firth) becomes involved with the close-knit residents of a North Carolina town after he arrives with a controversial plan to save their crumbling community.

programme.title: Compliance
programme.desc: A fast-food worker (Dreama Walker) who's accused of theft is put through the wringer as her boss (Ann Dowd), at the direction of a phone caller who says he's a cop, subjects her to increasingly harsh forms of interrogation.
A man (Anthony Hopkins) searches for his missing daughter in one of several vignettes dealing with issues of love, loss and betrayal.

programme.title: Lucky
programme.desc: A 90-year-old atheist has outlived and out-smoked his contemporaries, and as he comes to terms with his own mortality, he searches for ever-elusive enlightenment.

programme.title: Then She Found Me
programme.desc: Life deals a few heavy blows to April (Helen Hunt), a 39-year-old schoolteacher. Though she is desperate for a baby, her husband (Matthew Broderick) has decided to end their brief marriage. April barely has a chance to recover from the shock, when Bernice (Bette Midler), a brassy and selfish TV personality, barges into her life, claiming to be her mother.

programme.title: World's Most Expensive Fails
programme.desc: We'd like to supersize your fails on this episode!

programme.title: World's Most Expensive Fails
programme.desc: When high-value items meet low-effort mistakes, the results are jaw-dropping and wallet-crushing.
programme.sub-title: World's Most Expensive Fails | Priceless or Pointless?

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that willw ork in any kitchen. The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Calabria is famous for its fiery salami spread, 'Nduja. It is delicious on warm grilled bread, and Lidia shows viewers how to make a Bruschetta with 'Nduja; she then makes Raw and Cooked Salad for Summer with green beans and tomatoes, a wonderful way to enjoy seasonal vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about family in this episode as Lidia shares three of her favorite family recipes. Marinated Meatballs, Zucchini Parmigiana, Artichoke Carbonara and Jam Filler Mezzaluna are the stars of this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their crespelle or crepes. In this episode, Lidia teaches viewers how to stuff them with tomato and grated cheese. Today's menu includes: Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad, "Crespelle Manicotti" stuffed with ricotta and mozzarella and for dessert, an Italian classic - beautiful Strawberries Topped with Balsamic Vinegar, a Lidia favorite.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fuzi with chicken ragu; no-bake chocolate ricotta brick cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto; poached chicken and giardiniera salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It doesn't get any better in an Italian kitchen than when Lidia makes fish and vegetables. In this episode, she prepares a nice and refreshing Pan Seared Shrimp with Arugula Pesto. Her next dish is Butterflied Trout, fried in a pan with Bacon and Basil served with a Zucchini Dish made with Anchovies and Capers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fettuccine with caramelized onions, bacon and olives; orange spritz; roast chicken with rosemary and lemon.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the balance today as Lidia pairs some unexpected ingredients that result in the best of flavors. She starts the meal with her Prosciutto and Fig Bruschetta: grilled bread topped with a salty sweet combination of prosciutto and fig jam; Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens: spaghetti tossed with fennel, escarole and a splash of balsamic; Chocolate Anise Biscotti: the "twice cooked" Italian cookie made with chocolate and anise.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia introduces this episode with "Beautiful vegetables and a hot oven: a great marriage!" She then begins the meal with a simple and refreshing Sesame and Fava Bean Dip, perfect for flatbreads. Next, she prepares a Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of Baked Potatoes is made with Pancetta and Oregano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves a good roast. It brings out unimaginable flavors, and the aromas from the kitchen will beckon your family to the table. Today's menu includes Red Onions Stuffed with Rice; a Roast Pork Shoulder with Roast Vegetable Sauce, and a brown sugar, bourbon and warm Baked Pineapple served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. She'll also show you how to prepare an easy dessert spread with seasonal fruits and a few store-bought sweet Italian specialties.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian cuisine is known for seasonal ingredients and simple techniques. In today's episode, Lidia will share recipes that master simplicity: Sausages with Fennel & Olives; Orange and Red Salad and a delicious "Almost a Tiramisu" recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a young girl, from a small, rural setting, the majestic skyscrapers of Manhattan were quite the sight for Lidia. As a young teenager, Lidia was in charge of most dinners since her parents were returning home late in the evening, and soups were a popular choice to feed the family. In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Yellow saffron seafood and leek risotto; how to replenish stock using food scraps from the freezer; barley risotto with cabbage and sausage.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The egg is a staple ingredient in any kitchen and should not be overlooked or overcooked. In this episode, Lidia shows you the classic technique of poaching an egg and making a Warm Mushroom Salad: a bed of frisee with a warm medley of mixed wild mushrooms, pancetta and a poached egg; Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce: a simple and delicious tomato Sauce poached egg served with slices of grilled country bread and Brutti ma Buoni, a classic Italian hazelnut cookie made with meringue.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes make the perfect canvas for any recipe, and in today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite dishes featuring this juicy, delicious staple of Italian cuisine. Her menu includes Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce, served over easy on top of a crunchy slice of grilled country bread; Stuffed Tomatoes, filled with a classic combination of rice, mozzarella and basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a large pot of bubbling polenta, a dish that she grew up with and loved. From that polenta, she'll bake Crostini with Mixed Mushrooms and Cheese which is a perfect starter to any meal. Her granddaughter, Julia, joins her in the kitchen to help assemble and of course, taste! She'll then prepare a Hearty Polenta Dish with Bacon and Broccoli, a perfect combination. Finally, she'll make Sweet Skillet Sausage with Mixed Grapes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about freash seafood in this episode with three of Lidia's most requested fish recipes: Clam Brushetta features crusty Italian bread, still warm from the grill with clam sauce; Halibut Baked with Mushrooms in a Lemon and White Wine Sauce is a great weekend meal as is Grouper with Potatoes and Peppers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the grill today since Italians love a "grigliata mista" or Italian grilled platters of meats, seafood and vegetables. Today, Lidia shares a menu that your guests will love as well. On the menu is Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis; Grilled Apple and Radicchio Salad with Gorgonzola and a flavorful Tuscan Maremma Style Steak.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, Cheese Roasted Asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, Baked Eggplant with Tomatoes, created with cheese, herbs and topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an Almond Torte with Chocolate Chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians don't like to eat big pieces of meat, but they do like to braise small pieces with lots of vegetables into delicious ragus. In this episode, Lidia creates a delicious meal of Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; mouthwatering Lamb Ragu prepared with an array of peppers and potatoes and for a sweet finish, a Gianduia Cake made of hazelnuts and chocolate- a Piedmontese tradition.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Casseroles have a place in everyone's heart and home. Today Lidia shares a delicious and hearty Italian style version of Layered Casserole of Beef, Cabbage and Potatoes topped with fontina cheese - a one pot meal fit to feed any hungry crowd. Lidia then stews apples and dried fruit in her Spiced Fruit Compote and adds spices like clove and cinnamon - a heartwarming tea; Lastly, she is joined by Grandma for her Coffee Panna Cotta, an easy make-ahead dessert flavored with coffee and Sambuca.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Slow cooking does take a little time, but it is so rewarding! Today Lidia shares some classic techniques that will make show-stopping dishes for any occasion. Lidia prepares an elegant Risotto with Mushrooms, finished with parsley, cheese and butter. She'll then prepare a luscious Ziti with Pork Rib Guazzetto. Lidia then shows you how breathe new life into your risotto leftovers by breading it and frying it to make a delicious snack or serve it over a salad for a complete meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Are you always in rush to prepare soemthing quick yet delicious for dinnertime? In this episode Lidia shares three of her favorite quick and simple meal ideas-all of which can work as an appetizer, a lunch or quick dinner. They include Scallops, Scallion and Mushrooms, Chicken Breasts with Orange and Gaeta Olives, Tuna with Mimosa Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says "Family Time " Pork and Grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu, she prepares Pork Medallions with grapes, Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Ornage in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian sweets are today's focus and include: Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait; Chocolate Zabaglione and Raspberry & Walnut Butter Cookies

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves long cooking techniques and braising but often, one just wants to prepare quick and delicious meals using the same technique. In this episode, she teaches the viewer to do just that. Her first dish is a velvety Lettuce Soup in a Fontina Gratin; she then makes a juicy but super quick Pork Tenderloin with Balsamic Onions. Lastly, she prepares String Beans with Rocky Mashed Potatoes made with garlic and olive oil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's another episode dedicated to simplicity and delicious ingredients. Here Lidia chooses three great dishes that can be made in very little time but offer great flavors and complexity. They are great as appetizers, sides or by themselves and include Caprese Salad with Celery and Walnuts, Stuffed Artichokes with Tuna and Scallop Salad
programme.sub-title: Quick Light and Easy Meal Ideas

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today it's all about the braise. To start, Lidia makes a unique Salad of Radicchio and Oranges, a perfect blend of bitter and sweet. She then makes a heartwarming Braised Chicken Thigh dish with Potatoes and Olives, a family favorite. For another braise, she demonstrates a simple technique with cauliflower that brings out the nutty flavor of this underused vegetable.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to drink wine with their meals and cook with it as well. In this episode, Lidia shares a meal where wine plays a part of each delicious dish: Sausage Crostini: a toasted piece of bread topped with sweet Italian sausage and topped with taleggio cheese; Linguine with White Clam Sauce: a simple white wine clam sauce served with linguine pasta; Braised Beef Rolls: stuffed beef rolls oozing with the flavors of prosciutto, provolone and golden raisins served in a red wine tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta! In this episode, Lidia starts with the simplest- a Spaghettini with Olive Oil and Rosemary, then moves on to a hearty dish of Tagliatelle with Metaballs and eggplant, and finishes with a delicious whole wheat pasta - Baked Whole Wheat Penne with Ceci Beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Thanksgiving Comes Early

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke

programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Bird Meets Smoke

Great chicken!"

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Simple is best. As proof, Mary Ann's recipe for Tuscany-inspired Prato Almond Cake is as simple to prepare as it is delicious to eat. Then it's on to the dark and mysteriously magical Dried Plum and Balsamic Vinegar Tart as intense to the taste buds as it is to the imagination. Vinegar. Who knew? Answer: Mary Ann.

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann goes back in time to prepare a childhood favorite: Nonna Galasso's Fried Ricotta with Salad Tomatoes on Crostini. Then it's back to the present with light-as-a-cloud Ricotta Gnocchi. And for a sweet, creamy finish, Ricotta Cheese with Honey and Almonds. Ricotta, you gotta'.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Ricotta! / Cucinare con la Ricotta!

programme.title: Ciao Italia

Then he fires up the grill for a more upscale dinnertime feast of Beef Tagliata con Patate Duchesse.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Tuscan Supper / Cena Toscana

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Say what? Cauliflower Crust Pizza? Mary Ann does more than say it, she makes her deeply satisfying, low-cal classic. You don't, when you can mash up cauliflower and enjoy guilt-free, fabulous Cauliflower Mashed Potatoes.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Cauliflower, Really? / Cavolfiore, Davvero?

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Nothing better than generous squares of fresh pasta "Handkerchiefs" tossed with a classic Ligurian Pesto Sauce. And if you have a sweet tooth, Mary Ann has just the thing, when she combines raspberries, blueberries, and sliced strawberries, with sweet ricotta cheese and to create Fazzoletti with Fruit. The perfect dessert for a special occasion.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Little Hankies Two Ways / Piccoli Fazzoletti in Due Modi

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann prepares a luxurious Lamb Ragu to fill equally luxurious, freshly made Cannelloni. And if you're in the mood for an equally exquisite, vegetarian version wrapped inside a lightly browned crepe, then keep watching as she combines broccoli, plum tomatoes, lemon zest, ricotta cheese for Crepes with Vegetables and Cheese.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Exquisite Cannelloni / Cannelloni Squisiti

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann travels to cold waters off the Gulf of Maine to reap the harvest of Gary Moretti's Bangs Island Mussels. First up, keep it simple, with a variety of tangy, tasty, Gary's Awesome Aiolis. Then Mary Ann combines her signature potato salad with plump, succulent musses to create a unique and most memorable Mussel Potato Salad.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Make Mine Mussels / Prepara le mie cozze

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: You haven't lived until you've enjoyed Mary Ann's Neapolitan Style Stuffed Red Peppers. easy to prepare and the perfect main course. Then she cooks up a colorful casserole of sweet bell peppers, boiling onions and fresh tomatoes for a Peperonata. Want the perfect Sicilian-style topping for bruschetta? Try her Peppers with Garlic and Mint.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Peppers / Peperoni Ripieni Napoletani

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Tuna takes a creative turn when Mary Ann prepares Tuna Meatballs with Caponata, protein-rich fish topped with tangy Sicilian caponata. Then Mary Ann proves mealtime couldn't be easier when she rustles up Cous Cous with Tuna; lemony cous cous tossed with oil-packed tuna and crunchy pistachio nuts. You'll be hooked.

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann takes to the streets to enjoy one of Sicily's favorites: Panzerotti Palermitani, freshly made dough, stuffed with mozzarella "pearls" and tomato sauce, shaped like a turnover and then fried to a golden crisp. Then chickpeas take center stage for a sweet ravioli filled with chocolate, cinnamon, citron, honey, and toasted almonds.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Little Surprise Packages / Piccoli Pacchetti a Sorpresa

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Coffee expert Joey Chase goes on a pilgrimage along an ancient Ethiopian trading route that starts with the modern latte art cafes in Addis Ababa, then through the coffee kingdom of Jimma to the 10,000+-year-old wild coffee Yayu Forest. Village elders share the age-old secrets of hand processing, fire-pit roasting, and brewing of beans followed by a traditional feast.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: After sharing a first-ever taste of coffee in a remote Maasai village, followed by an exploration of the terrain with some new-found friends, Joey explores a grandiose coffee estate in Mt. Kenya. He then jousts with coffee buyers in Nairbobi's auction house and experiences the hand sorting and elaborate tasting of over 100 distinctive coffees in a British Tudor-style plantation cottage.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Touting the practicality of gondola travel, Joey explores the canals of Venice and discovers the oldest coffee shop in Europe. The trail to classic Italian espresso leads from Illy Coffee near the high-fashion metropolis of Trieste to the medieval town of Scarperia where espresso machines are manufactured. Florence boasts a famous barista who prepares a masterful farewell espresso.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: An exploration of Paris's distinctive cafe culture reveals a renaissance of coffee-inspired cuisine, pastries, and spirits. World-renowned "Noses" in the south of France reveal the complex contribution that fragrance and aroma make toward the perfect cup as Joey pursues the development of a coffee perfume.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Bob Marley's son Rohan takes Joey on a journey from the streets of Kingston to the peaks of the Blue Mountains. From waterfall plunges and grazing tropical fruits on Rohan's farm to roasting the smoothest coffee on earth and enjoying a Jamaican feast that ends with a Marley-hosted jam session, Joey discovers the pulse of Jamaica through the lens of Marley Coffee.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: From four-star cuisine to cappuccino on horseback, Joey explores the historic cobblestone streets and coffee estates of Antigua. A puddle jumper flight along the rims of active volcanoes leads to the age-old Mayan towns around Lake Atitlan where coffee-harvesting communities offer a glimpse of ancient traditions.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: The pursuit of the sweetest "honey" coffees on earth unleashes an adventure that includes "coffee monkeys", crocodiles, toucans, an exploration of the active crater of Volcan Poas, and surfing on the coast with a coffee farmer. The Costa Rican paradise reveals a uniquely artistic approach toward colorful honey coffees stored like wine and served just in time for a classic "coffee sock" brew.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Joey hits the streets of Bogota to check out the controversial trade in emeralds, the famous Juan Valdez Cafe, and some classic Colombian cuisine at an elevation of 10,000 feet. A flight to Armenia and subsequent Willy's Jeep trek uncover a remote and hidden world of quaint coffee towns and boutique farms where Joey hosts a group of international coffee buyers.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Joey is welcomed to Sao Paulo with a freshly brewed cup of excellence at The Coffee Lab in the trendy Madalena district. Joey checks out big coffee exporting in the Port of Santos with shipping containers stacked like legos, Jaco bird coffee (foraged from bird poop), and the world's largest savannah grassland, where Daterra Coffee Farms researches small-lot coffees on a massive scale.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Following an excursion to the extremely remote Gnobe Bugle Village, Joey Jeep-treks the terrain from the top of Volcan Baru. The search for coffee known to cost $1,000 per pound leads Joey to the eclectic town of Boquete, a plunge-worthy volcanic river-filled-crevasse, and awe-inspiring Gesha coffee farms with more rainbows and hummingbirds than one could possibly imagine.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie visits a busy office where stress has led to junk food snacking and fast-food lunching. Recipes include Herbed Farro Salad with Chicken, Walnuts, Feta and Spinach, Asian Chicken Wrap, and Buffalo Chicken Salad.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Office Food Overhaul

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

Ellie demystifies the gluten issue once and for all with the help of her stepbrother and yoga instructor David Wilder, who has celiac disease. In this episode, Ellie also underscores just how many foods are naturally gluten-free, with recipes that will satisfy everyone. Recipes include Multigrain Pancakes, Steak au Poivre Salad, Roasted Salmon & Fennel with Lemon & Thyme, and more.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Gluten Free Home

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Does sugar have you in its thrall? Ellie helps one family tackle their sugar quandary so they can continue to do the baking they love in a healthier way without sacrificing flavor. programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Sweet Tooth Satisfiers

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

Ellie helps a frazzled couple trying to get healthy weeknight dinners on the table when conflicting schedules and priorities intervene. Recipes include Shrimp with Spinach, Garlic and Smoked Paprika, Peach Chicken with Crispy Bread Crumbs, and Mango-Coconut Sorbet.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Crazy Schedule Dinner Challenge

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

It's Ellie to the rescue with flexible recipes that will bring them together. programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Herbivore VS Carnivore

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Teeny Kitchen

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

Recipes include Curried Chickpea Wraps (Roti), Jerk Pork Loin with Mango Cucumber Salsa, Grilled Pineapple with Coconut Whip, and mango-avocado salad.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Spring Break with No Regrets

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In the orchards of upstate New York, Georgia Pellegrini explores the idea of "uncultivation"--a way of working with nature rather than controlling it. From regenerative apple growing to slow-crafted cider and brandy, she meets makers who transform fruit into something lasting, revealing how time, patience and imperfection shape both flavor and meaning.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Apples

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In Maine, Georgia Pellegrini explores the delicate balance between wild ecosystems and the people who steward them. From ancient wild blueberry barrens to regenerative oyster farms and cutting-edge marine research, she follows a network of growers, fishers and scientists working in sync with nature -- revealing how diversity, care and innovation can sustain both food systems and the future.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Maine

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In the Western Catskills, Georgia Pellegrini follows a young couple who return to a childhood home and reimagine it as a regenerative farm. Through soil, animals and shared meals, they rediscover a deeper connection to land and community -- revealing how staying, tending and working with nature can transform both a place and the people who call it home.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Uplands

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In Texas, Georgia Pellegrini traces the story of yaupon -- North America's only native source of caffeine. Once dismissed as a nuisance, this plant reveals a deeper story: of land out of balance, of restoration through stewardship and of Indigenous traditions nearly lost. As farmers, scientists and communities reconnect with yaupon, it becomes a bridge between ecology, culture and renewal.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Yaupon

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In the Ozark hills of Missouri, Georgia Pellegrini steps inside East Wind Community -- an egalitarian experiment in shared living. Here, land, labor and resources are held in common, and decisions are made collectively. As she joins daily life and conversation, she explores what it means to build a life rooted in cooperation and a more connected, communal way of living.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - East Wind

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In a quiet winter landscape, Georgia Pellegrini explores a more thoughtful holiday -- one rooted in simplicity, sustainability and handmade tradition. From repurposed treasures to shared meals and creative rituals, she visits kindred spirits who reveal how small, meaningful moments -- the "glimmers" -- can transform the season into something lasting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Christmas

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: For many species the possession of territory is the ultimate goal. With good territory comes plentiful food, access to shelter, attraction to mates and safety to raise offspring - all tremendous strategic advantages in the wild. For a territorial species, their territory is their kingdom. Those that want it will stop at nothing to get it, and those that have it will fight fiercely to defend it.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: To provide an edge to survive in their habitats, some animals have developed techniques that allow them to share information. Communication represents one of the most versatile and widely used strategies in the animal world. In both social and solitary species it is the transfer of information that lies at the heart of so many behaviours in the wild. For those that harness the power of communication, the advantage is theirs.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: From microscopic single celled organisms to the largest animals on the planet, one goal is shared by all living things: to reproduce. For many creatures, finding a suitable mate to pass on strong genes and rear young that will survive to adulthood is a challenge that is met with a variety of strategies. In this episode we will observe the creative tactics animals employ to find the best mates and to win them over.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: The ability to fight and win is essential to any animal living in the wild. The strategies of that fight are known as agonism, and it can be used to establish hierarchy, secure resources, win territory and seduce mates. In the wild, there are no guarantees. But those that master agonism have the best chance of seeing another day.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: The real hard work for a physically powerful predator is in working out a strategy for attack.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: Whatever strategy an animal uses to withstand an attack, they will do what it takes to survive the wild.

programme.desc: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice, but can Monty set them on the right track?

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives his top tips for filling gaps in the summer borders, using an array of plants to extend the season and take the garden into the autumn and beyond. Rachel de Thame explores a garden in Devon which has been transformed from a pig farm into a colourful paradise, and Frances Tophill discovers the surprising medicinal and homoeopathic properties of some of Britain's favourite garden plants.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is thinking ahead to the next year and makes a start on adding foxtail lilies to his borders, Rachel de Thame delves into the extraordinary world of bees, and Arit Anderson visits a green oasis where texture and form take centre stage.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty continues his preparations for the next year by getting some daffodils in the ground. He gives his summer-fruiting raspberries a prune, plants a fragrant honeysuckle on the Mound, and offers up some advice on how best to deal with that gardeners' nemesis, bindweed. programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.
programme.sub-title: Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!
programme.sub-title: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.
programme.sub-title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!
programme.sub-title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh

programme.title: The Persian Empire
programme.desc: Cyrus, the first great king of the Persian Empire, expands the empire through pragmatic leadership; he uses local customs and traditions and thereby gains legitimacy over Central Asia and Babylon; his son Cambyses expands the empire into Egypt.
programme.sub-title: Cyrus and Cambyses - Founders of the Empire

programme.title: The Persian Empire
programme.desc: Whether Darius, the son-in-law of Cyrus, is a legitimate king; After Cambyses dies, Darius establishes himself as an unwavering leader; Darius creates a royal genealogy and a Persian identity; he then turns to building infrastructure.
programme.sub-title: Darius I - Creator of the Imperial System

programme.title: The Persian Empire
programme.desc: The five Persian capitals; Pasargadae, Ecbatana, Babylon, Susa and Persepolis; built in strategic, fortified locations, these cities are major symbols of power for the great kings; exploring the great hall at Persepolis, which holds 10,000 guests.

programme.title: The Persian Empire
programme.desc: Seeing beyond the outside stereotypes of Persian kings as tyrants; seeing what the kings themselves have to say; in sculpted reliefs and carvings on royal tombs, the words and images of Darius and Xerxes show Persian values of harmonious cooperation.
programme.sub-title: The Great King - Images and Realities

programme.title: The Persian Empire
programme.desc: A trip into the western provinces; the empire's diverse local customs; the Persian Empire is famous for its roads and bridges; how its express messenger system allows information to travel quickly; the king keeps tabs on every corner of the empire.

programme.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World
programme.desc: The past comes alive when considering the imaginary lives of ordinary people; these include the citizens, soldiers and slaves who live on the other side of history; asking questions that many textbooks never ask.
programme.sub-title: Taking On the Other Side of History

programme.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World
programme.desc: Taking a look at the lives of human ancestors; picturing oneself as a Neanderthal, whose life is dominated by the environment; discovering the significance of the human mind, language and art in the Old Stone Age.

programme.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World
programme.desc: Stepping into the world's earliest permanent settlement; why the development of agriculture is a revolution; the invention of writing; the creation of laws; an increase in trade; technological innovations such as the wheel.

programme.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World
programme.desc: What it is like to be an ancient Egyptian; exploring everyday life during the New Kingdom era; the richness of the Nile; the conservatism and stability of the society; relics that survive across millennia, such as hieroglyphics, papyri and art.

programme.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World
programme.desc: An overview of the past 500 years of European history and culture; the system of government; economic structures; science and technology; the literature, art and music.

programme.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World
programme.desc: How the physical realities of Europe and the Atlantic world shaped its destiny; geography and climate affecting patterns of population, immigration, diplomacy, war, and political and cultural divisions.

programme.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World
programme.desc: The Great Chain of Being, which assumed an ordered, hierarchical universe in which humans were placed in a particular rank by God; Europe emerging from the Middle Ages; how the concept was challenged and strained by various forces.

programme.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World
programme.desc: A revived interest in the literary and historical works of classical Greece and Rome; new ideas about the qualifications of a gentleman, the role of women and the expectations of a prince; a resulting emphasis on literacy and education.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.
